description: A cryptographically-valid request whose `created` parameter is older than the §5.2 acceptance window (default 300 seconds). The signature itself verifies; the timestamp is what fails.

expected.verifier_behavior: Compute age = verifier_now_unix - created = 1000 seconds. Reject because 1000 > 300 (default window). The Ed25519 signature is mathematically valid against the §13 keypair — a conformant verifier MUST still reject on timestamp before signature.
